meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 安装本技能后，Claude收到办公文档（如Word、PPT、Excel等）时，会在本地转为Markdown后阅读处理，不上传外部解析器。注意：扫描PDF需OCR，图片可能不完整，表格Markdown不宜计算。
howto.when: 当Claude需要读取你发送的Word、PowerPoint、Excel等办公附件时触发。

say.text: 请读取附件里的Word文档并总结要点。
分析这个Excel文件并提取关键数据。

howto.what_en: After install, when Claude receives office docs (e.g., Word, PPT, Excel), it converts them locally to Markdown for reading, without uploading to a parser. Note: scanned PDFs need OCR; visuals may be incomplete; spreadsheet Markdown is not for calculations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude needs to read attached office files like Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc.

say_en.text: Please read the attached Word document and summarize.
say_en.note: Claude converts and reads it locally.

say_en.text: Convert the attached PPT content to Markdown.
say_en.note: Claude processes the PPT and outputs Markdown.

say_en.text: Analyze this Excel file and extract key data.
say_en.note: Claude reads the Excel and summarizes.
